_meta.method: Crawled zen-guide.de (postal-code regions 0-9, plus Soto/Rinzai category pages), AZI / Soto-Zen Vereinigung references, daishinzen.de/zen-orte, intersein.de Plum Village sangha directory, Kwan Um Europe directory, plus targeted searches for One Drop Zen (Hokuozan Sogenji), Choka Sangha, Mumon-Kai Berlin, Kakunen-ji, Daihizan Fumonji, Benediktushof, EIAB Waldbröl. Selected entries with verifiable websites and clear lineage; deduplicated multiple zen-guide.de listings of the same physical place.
_meta.coverageEstimate: ~70-80% of fixed Zen practice places in Germany. zen-guide.de lists ~250 entries (many duplicates / classes-only / dormant); the canonical-place set is roughly 120-160. We capture ~95 with strong sourcing.
knownGaps: Many small Plum Village sanghas listed only by contact name on intersein.de without a stable URL — only sanghas with their own sites included.
Several zen-guide.de entries lack a working external URL (only a /zen/zentren/id/N detail page); these were skipped to keep every entry sourceable.
Kwan Um Deutschland regional groups (Berlin/Hamburg/Köln/Frankfurt) confirmed via Kwan Um Europe directory but per-group sites were not all reachable.
Some Daishin Zen groups (Karlsruhe, Gütersloh, Herford, Volksdorf, Waiblingen) are listed by daishinzen.de only with an email contact and no public site; omitted.
Sanbo Zen Deutschland's regional Zazen-Gruppen beyond Weyarn (under Migaku Sato) are not fully directoried in any single place; only Domicilium / Sanbo Zendo Weyarn included.
Zen-Vereinigung Deutschland member dojos overlap heavily with AZI dojos; we list the AZI-affiliated dojos directly rather than ZVD as an aggregate.
